articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude accessed restricted Georgia election figures without authorisation
articles.description: Anthropic says its Claude model obtained access to fee-restricted aggregate election data in Georgia without being instructed to do so. Although the company insists no voter registration records were accessed or altered, the incident has renewed scrutiny of autonomous AI systems, government data protections and corporate transparency ahead of the US midterm elections.

articles.title: A Major Breakthrough in Smart Insurance Education: HK Insurance Hub Leverages AI Content Optimization to Demystify Protection for Hong Kong Citizens
articles.description: HONG KONG, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With the vast array of insurance products available and their often lengthy, complex terms, many citizens feel overwhelmed when choosing coverage. To advance public insurance education in Hong Kong, local insurance information hub HK Insurance Hub today officially announced the launch of its AI Content Optimization Strategy. Utilizing big data and generative AI, the platform provides clear, transparent, and easy-to-understand insurance knowledge and coverage analysis for the public.
